headline: Committee replaces Bill 164 with revised version, discusses Kahuluʻi land bills

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to replace Bill 164 with the proposed CD1 version
meeting.summary: Bill 163 would put Kahuluʻi land inside the urban growth boundary, and Bill 164 would change its plan use to business multifamily. Bill 165 is held for the Land Use Commission; full council will learn if five or six votes are needed.
meeting.recap: Bill 163 would put land in Kahului inside the island's urban growth boundary.[[0:05:58]] Bill 164 would change the land's community plan use from agriculture to business multifamily.[[0:07:13]] The planning director suggested waiting until a land inventory update is done and the public can take part.[[0:32:37]] The project representative said a first phase of about 270 units could be ready by mid-2029.[[0:42:59]] Another testifier asked the council to oppose the project or delay it until a final environmental study is approved.[[1:03:33]] Full council will learn whether five or six votes are needed to pass the bills.[[2:34:17]]
decided: The committee replaced Bill 164 with a revised version (CD1) that corrects the property size.
meeting.next: The chair said Bill 165 would be held until the committee hears back from the Land Use Commission on the district boundary amendment. The chair said a public hearing would also have to be scheduled for Bill 163. The project representative agreed to work with the chair on getting the word out before each chance for public testimony. The chair said the housing director will be in contact with the project representative. The bills go to full council, where members will learn if five or six votes are needed.
